results.title: Yulu forays into Nashik for EV-powered deliveries
results.content: Nashik is Yulu’s second market in Maharashtra after Mumbai, where its hyperlocal EV ecosystem has helped delivery persons with affordable green rides

results.title: Kotian caps a career-best haul to set up Mumbai’s win
results.content: Kotian claimed eight for 84 to finish with a match haul of 11 wickets as Haryana was bowled out for 256 at the stroke of tea

results.title: High security, traffic curbs and midnight Metro services for Diljit Dosanjh’s Delhi concert
results.content: Around 70,000 spectators expected at JLN Stadium on October 30; around 2,000 private guards, traffic curbs from 1 p.m. and no public parking near venue.

results.title: Traffic restrictions around JLN Stadium for Diljit Dosanjh concert on October 30
results.content: Diversions are likely from 1 p.m. to midnight across 11 roads; Delhi Traffic Police advises commuters to use the Metro and concertgoers to follow designated routes and drop-off points

results.title: The examination overload, its enormous cost
results.content: India’s obsession with layers of examinations must end, and the focus must return to the forgotten value of sustained academic performance

results.title: Foreign Secretary to visit Kathmandu as plans get underway for Nepal PM’s India visit
results.content: Nepal PM Balendra Shah is expected to visit Delhi by the end of the year, in what would be his first bilateral visit abroad, as he has been focused on domestic issues
